door_reduction.why_not: Remove the relay startup automatic transport producer. Remaining catalogCommit transport calls are image/audio; builtin selection requires explicit video protocol. Runtime create and result-query are separate lifecycle callers, and JSON readers remain necessary for declared URL results. The modelRetype wrapper must retain a distinct reclassification entry, but calls the same draftShapeForKind boundary and cannot manufacture video operations. Generic perf registration adds two validation readers: the subprocess wrapper rejects failed/partial instruments before accepting a result, and the registry driver independently validates requested metrics. Existing registry readers in structural tests, validation and the unified runner retain their distinct lifecycle roles; UI drivers are unchanged. Script doors were generated separately with --roots=scripts,tests/perf --include-tests; the root checker default scan covers application roots only.
